G-docs-verifier-runbook.rule: One docs repair on PR 6; preserve unrelated runbook edits and do not merge from the worker.

G-native-serial-evidence.rule: One native owner at a time. Do not install, launch, drive, uninstall, or reset concurrently; use the exact explicit UDID and preserve app data unless a separately scoped disposable onboarding fixture is approved.

G-chat-transcript-core.rule: Verification units are read-only. Any code change requires a new bounded repair spec naming the failing criterion and exact owner files; never preemptively rewrite merged transcript code.

G-session-list.rule: Do not combine session-row visual work with header work unless evidence proves a shared defect.

G-navigation-shell.rule: Navigation and settings/task surfaces are separately accepted; no broad shell redesign.

G-settings-profiles.rule: Profile-scoped settings and group creation must not be changed in parallel.

G-onboarding.rule: Manual entry remains; no SSH/automatic installer or personal endpoint assumptions.

G-tasks-kanban.rule: Bots/Tasks loading acceptance and Groups execution are distinct; no contract invention.

G-teams-groups.rule: Blocked until an explicitly approved disposable two-profile fixture exists.

G-live-activity.rule: No APNs keys, relay, deployment, or widget mutation is authorized by this seed.

G-performance-probe.rule: Probe work stays opt-in and additive; no timing callback or screenshot may be represented as physical FPS proof.

G-verifier-lane.rule: Keep STOP/old-Hermes lane authority intact; no scheduler cutover or unattended activation from a seed.

G-device-evidence.rule: Physical-device checks are serial and require human/device authority; simulator results do not substitute.

first_rolling_wave.rationale: Queue all bounded units, but dispatch only dependency-ready units whose ownership groups do not conflict. Native/device verification remains serial.

first_rolling_wave.serial_execution_rule: One native/device verifier at a time; cloud implementers may run concurrently only across non-conflicting ownership groups.
